items.evidence: daymarket.py --headless --ticks 5 with empty script: tick 5, screen title, every key of the brief present (checked against the full key list).
--frame title.png: PNG signature, IHDR 800 x 480; many frames opened and viewed.
Fresh save: texts [Day Market, New season, Records, Stamps, Settings, Quit], menu_index 0; up,up -> 0; down x9 -> 4; down x5 + enter at tick 0 with --ticks 20 -> tick 0, state printed.
Settings texts Settings/Language: English/Difficulty: Normal/Season: 7 days/Back; left stops at English/Easy/7 days, right stops at Spanish/Hard/3 days; Escape and Enter on Back -> title.
Set es/easy/3 in one run; next run on same save starts es, easy, 3. Fresh save: en, normal, 7, slots [null,null,null], stamps [], records [].

Spanish texts checked on title, both slots headings, settings (changes at once), records, stamps, morning, stall, day, paused, evening, season over: all Spanish. But the Upgrades screen can never be reached (Enter on Evening goes straight to the next Morning), so its Spanish could not be shown on that screen.
data/strings.json holds an en and an es table; README 'New language' paragraph says how to add one.
Enter on title: [New season, Slot 1: Empty, Slot 2: Empty, Slot 3: Empty]; Escape -> title.
enter,enter: morning, day 1, slot 1, coins 50, rep 50, empty stock, prices 4/6/11/14/7/9, upgrades [], crate_limit 8, order null, texts Morning, Day 1 of 7, Coins: 50.
Easy -> 60 coins, Hard -> 40; 3 days -> 'Day 1 of 3', forecast of 3; after changing settings to easy/7, Continue still shows season_difficulty hard, season_length 3.
Seeds 1,2,3,7,42: 7 entries from sun/cloud/rain/heat, weather = forecast[0], 'Weather: Cloud'/'Weather: Sun' matches; seed 1 gave the same forecast in every run.
Wholesale for 5 seeds all inside base-1..base+2 (e.g. seed 3 apples 1, cheese 8, honey 7); rows read 'Apples: 4 a unit, stock 0' with that price and stock.
Apples at 4: coins 50->26, stock [{6,5}], row 'stock 6'; second lot -> coins 2, [{12,5}], 'stock 12'; honey -> [{6,null}].
Fish lot with 14 coins: coins/stock unchanged, 'Not enough coins' appended, gone after next word (up). Crafted save with 96 apples and 500 coins: lot does nothing; 93 apples -> 99 allowed.
Day 1 order null, accept does nothing; day 2 orders e.g. 8 fish 168, 6 fish 126, 4 apples 24; accept -> taken true, 'Order taken: 8 Fish for 168'; second accept leaves identical state.
Later run on same save: title [.., New season, Continue, Records, ..]; New season rows 'Slot 1: Day 1 of 7, 50 coins'.

Season at day 2 (seed 5) with stall, prices; Continue in a run with --seed 99 gives identical day, coins, rep, stock, stall, prices, upgrades, forecast, wholesale, order. Enter on empty slot 2 stays on slots.

Paused texts [Paused, Resume, Title]; Resume/Escape restore morning (menu kept), stall cursor kept, day clock stood (10 at pause, 12 after 200 paused ticks + 10). Across runs Title leaves the slot as saved. But in the same run, buy apples -> Escape -> Title -> Continue -> slot 1 opens with coins 50 and the 6 apples bought that Morning still in stock: the saved slot shares the live season's stock.
Stall: cursor (0,0), selected apples, texts [Stall, Day 1 of 7, Good: Apples, Price: 4, Stock: 6, Crates: 0 of 8, Enter: open] after buying 6 apples.
down,left at (0,0) -> (0,0); up,up,right x7 -> (5,1); up,right,down -> (1,0).
next_good x0..6: apples, bread, cheese, fish, flowers, honey, apples with Good/Price texts following; prev_good: honey, flowers, fish.
put sequence -> stall entries and 'Crates: 3 of 8'; put on occupied cell no change; 8 crates then further puts refused 'Crates: 8 of 8'; take removes; take on empty cell no change.
price_up x10 -> apples 12 'Price: 12'; price_down x10 -> 1; fish up x40 -> 42.
Stall (apples 0,0; bread 0,1) and prices apples 5, bread 5 kept into day 2 Stall, and identical after Continue in a later run.
Enter on stall: screen day, clock 0, speed slow, texts include '08:00', 'Speed: Slow', counters 0, 54 visitors listed, tills one entry.
64 visitors: ids 1..64, minutes strictly increasing 18..415, all 4 types, want counts 2/1/2/3 distinct; same seed same list, season seed 2 another list.

slow: clock 1 on tick 20; fast: +1 per 5 ticks; rush: +1 per tick; hold: 100 ticks, clock unchanged, tick +100, screen day; slow 10 ticks then fast -> clock 1 on 3rd fast tick; texts '08:03', 'Speed: Hold' follow.
finish at tick 0 -> evening, clock 480; all fields equal to the same day run at rush except tick.
Same crafted day at slow, fast, rush and mixed (hold/fast/slow/rush/fast changes): identical coins, taken, served, walked_out, passed, sales, stock, evening texts.
Minute-by-minute check over whole days: every aisle visitor x == clock - minute, present from m to m+5, absent from m+6; queued joined == m+6.
Stall with different front/back goods per column, minute-by-minute: back-row takes (20) only when basket held something or front was taken that minute; never an unwanted or repeated good.
Apples crate in column 0 and 3: cook at price 4 holds 2 apples at 4 at clock m+c, budget 40->32; price 5 none; tourist at 6 takes 1 (budget 14); at 7 none.
Invariant run every minute of several days: budget_left = budget - spent, never negative; held units across aisle, queue and tills never exceed stock.
Busy day per-minute check: visitors leaving with empty basket counted in passed exactly; with goods they join the queue end with joined m+6 (or take a free till).
Every till start had ends = s+2+goods; each sale at that minute with paid = total (bargain 15 -> 14); coins/taken/served/rep moved accordingly; units left the days_left 1 batch before the 5 batch.
Busy one-till day: whenever a service ended with a queue, the till was occupied in the same minute; visitors from the aisle reached a free till at minute m+6.
No queued wait ever >= patience; 5 walk-outs each left at wait == patience with rep -2 and walked_out +1; held<=stock invariant kept afterwards.
Clock 479 -> next tick: evening, clock 480, aisle/queue/tills emptied, walked_out and passed unchanged.
Second till cannot be bought: Upgrades screen is unreachable. With a hand-written kept slot holding second_till, tills had 2 entries and 2 served at once, but not through the game.
Sign cannot be bought (Upgrades unreachable); not observable in play.
Day 2 order 8 fish/168: with 12 fish taken -> coins +168, 4 fish left, 'Order delivered: 168'; with no fish -> rep 50->45 'Order failed'; not taken -> no change, no line.
Bread bought day 1 -> 'Bread: sold 0, spoiled 6, left 0' that evening; fish bought day 1 days_left 1 that evening, spoiled 6 on day 2 evening; honey 6 units unchanged after 3 days.
Heat day without Cool box: apples days_left 5->3 (correct). Cool box cannot be bought (Upgrades unreachable); only a hand-written slot with cool_box showed 5->4.
3 crates: 'Rent: 26' Normal, 'Rent: 21' Easy, 'Rent: 36' Hard, coins reduced accordingly.
Evening texts Evening, Day 1 of 7, Taken 571, Served 26, Walked out 1, Passed 37 (= state), per-good lines matching sales and stock, Rent: 36, Coins, Reputation, 'Tomorrow: Sun' = forecast[1].
Enter on the Evening of a continuing season goes straight to 'Morning, Day 2 of 7'; the Upgrades screen never opens (game.py on_evening calls start_morning).
No upgrade can be bought: Upgrades screen unreachable.
Hard, 8 crates, no stock: Evening 'Coins: -6' ... 'Bankrupt', slots all null; Enter -> [Bankrupt, Score: 0, Days: 1, Best: 0, Enter: title]; records {0,1,hard,bankrupt true}.
Easy 3 days: evening 'Coins: 15', 'Season over'; Enter -> [Season over, Score: 65, Days: 3, Best: 65, Enter: title]; slot emptied, title without Continue; with another slot held Continue stays.

After 7 ended seasons: 5 kept, [Score 65, 3 days, Easy x2, Score 59, 3 days, Easy, Score 0, 1 days, Hard, bankrupt, Score 0, 2 days, Hard, bankrupt] (earlier first on ties), shown in later run; fresh 'No records yet'.
'Stamp: First coin' shown day 1, not again on day 2 with 21 served; stamps in stamp order; Stamps screen in a later run 'First coin: yes', 'Sold out: yes', rest ': no'.
Paid day -> first_coin, no-sale day -> none; 8 crates -> full_stall, 7 -> none; easy 3-day finished -> whole_season.
Apples crate with 2 units sold to 0 -> sold_out; bread without crate gone by spoilage and fish crate with 0 stock -> no sold_out.
Day 2 played unbroken vs. Continue in a later run on a copy of the save with the same inputs: identical visitors, sales, texts, coins, stock, reputation.
Seed 4, 900 ticks, same script from two identical saves: identical JSON. Seed 1 vs 2: different forecast and wholesale.
Escape/left/put/accept/finish/rush on Evening, junk on title, morning (put/take/finish/rush/hold), stall (accept/finish/rush/hold), paused: states identical to without them.
data/game.json holds goods, visitor types, hourly rates, weather w/weights, upgrades, stamps; README 'Changing data' says how to change each.
Stall frame: 6x2 grid (back row on top), 7 crates in six colours where the state puts them, yellow cursor at (2,1), 'Good: Cheese', 'Price: 11', 'Crates: 7 of 8'.
Day frame at 10:10: stall crates, visitors 26/27/28 at aisle x 3/2/0 (cook white, tourist cyan), queue of 2 (cook, bargain orange), till V23, time, speed, coins, taken, served, reputation.
Settings, slots, morning, paused, evening, season over frames show their texts with the chosen row in yellow; the Upgrades screen cannot be reached, so its frame cannot be made.
README gives text play, the headless/frame command (worked as written), and save-dir files settings/slots/stamps/records.json.

defects: Enter on the Evening skips the Upgrades screen entirely; no upgrade can ever be bought in play.

In one run, a slot's saved season shares the live stock/prices/stall objects, so giving the day up and continuing in the same run keeps purchases made after the Morning save (coins revert, stock does not).
Headless stdout is written in the console code page (cp1252 here), not UTF-8, when Spanish accented text is printed through a pipe.
In every frame the 'AISLE' label overlaps the bottom of the stall grid.

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
